quotations.old_english: Hé byreþ blódig wæl . . . mearcaþ mórhopu
quotations.english: he (Grendel) will bear the bloody corse . . . will mark the marshy pools (with the blood)

source_text: Mór-hop, es; n. A pool in a marsh :-- Hé byreþ blódig wæl . . . mearcaþ mórhopu he (Grendel) will bear the bloody corse . . . will mark the marshy pools (with the blood), Beo. Th. 904; B. 450. Cf. fen-hop.
